passages.text: Ella usually helps at the school library on Friday afternoon. This week she has to visit her grandmother, so Max offers to take Ella’s place for one afternoon. Ella shows him how to check the books and where to put the returned ones. Pupils come and go as they return old books and choose new ones. Max writes down the questions he cannot answer so that he can ask the librarian later. Ella thanks him, and the library can keep its usual opening time.

parallelText.en: Ella usually helps at the school library on Friday afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 埃拉通常在周五下午去学校图书馆帮忙。

parallelText.en: This week she has to visit her grandmother, so Max offers to take Ella’s place for one afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 这周她要去看奶奶，因此马克斯主动提出代替埃拉一个下午。

parallelText.en: Ella shows him how to check the books and where to put the returned ones.
parallelText.zh: 埃拉向他展示如何检查书本，以及把归还的书放在哪里。

parallelText.en: Pupils come and go as they return old books and choose new ones.
parallelText.zh: 学生们来来往往，还旧书并挑选新书。

parallelText.en: Max writes down the questions he cannot answer so that he can ask the librarian later.
parallelText.zh: 马克斯把自己答不出的问题记下来，之后询问图书管理员。

parallelText.en: Ella thanks him, and the library can keep its usual opening time.
parallelText.zh: 埃拉向他道谢，图书馆也得以保持平常的开放时间。

wordHelp.meaning: a person who works in a library

passages.text: When Mei first stays at her aunt’s house, she misses her family very much. On the first night, she cries herself to sleep after saying goodnight to her parents by phone. The next morning, her aunt listens to her and helps her plan a call home each evening. Later, Mei sees her younger cousin nearly step on a toy and cries out, “Look down!” Her cousin stops safely, and they put the toys back in the box together. Mei still misses home, but the small plan and the time with her cousin make the visit easier.

parallelText.en: When Mei first stays at her aunt’s house, she misses her family very much.
parallelText.zh: 梅第一次住在姑姑家时，非常想念家人。

parallelText.en: On the first night, she cries herself to sleep after saying goodnight to her parents by phone.
parallelText.zh: 第一晚，和父母通电话道晚安后，她哭着睡着了。

parallelText.en: The next morning, her aunt listens to her and helps her plan a call home each evening.
parallelText.zh: 第二天早上，姑姑听她说话，帮助她安排每天晚上给家里打电话。

parallelText.en: Later, Mei sees her younger cousin nearly step on a toy and cries out, “Look down!”
parallelText.zh: 后来，梅看见表弟差点踩到玩具，大喊：“看看脚下！”

parallelText.en: Her cousin stops safely, and they put the toys back in the box together.
parallelText.zh: 表弟安全地停住脚步，他们一起把玩具收回盒子。

parallelText.en: Mei still misses home, but the small plan and the time with her cousin make the visit easier.
parallelText.zh: 梅仍然想家，但小计划和与表弟相处的时光，让这次暂住轻松了一些。
